messages:
Lucy (Partnerships): Hey folks — CloudPartner sent an "availability_heatmap.csv" but the columns aren't matching our cost model. Can someone check schema vs what we expect?
Omar - Finance: pinging @Lucy (Partnerships) — what fields do you need? price per GPU-hour? commitment_tier?
Sarah (Supply Ops): For the cost model we ingest: sku, region, start_date, end_date, reserved_price_usd_per_hr, spot_price_usd_per_hr, typical_preempt_pct, avg_capacity_per_hour, lead_time_days, commit_window_months, billing_key. Anything else?
Lucy (Partnerships): Exactly that + a reliability_score (0-1) and an optional notes column. Also we need effective_capacity_by_hour for 24h heatmap instead of a single avg if they can.
Mikel - PM: If they can't provide full 24h heatmap, we can accept buckets like peak/mid/offpeak with multipliers. Need to document fallback logic.
VendorBot: CloudPartner uploaded file: https://files.example.com/CloudPartner/availability_heatmap_v2.csv (sha256: b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184). Please confirm receipt. :white_check_mark:
Omar - Finance: Quick Q — are the prices in the CSV net of marketplace fee or gross? We assume gross and we apply our marketplace cut.
Anita - Legal: Need to confirm contractual minimum price floors before we model net pricing. @Omar, flag any partner price clauses we should enforce.
Sarah (Supply Ops): Requesting preemption spec: is "typical_preempt_pct" probability per hour or expected fraction of instances evicted during the day? We interpret it as hourly expected eviction probability. Clarify.
VendorBot: CloudPartner response: price fields are gross list prices. Preempt_pct is expected hourly preemption probability (0-1). They confirmed peak/mid/offpeak buckets available.
Lucy (Partnerships): Good. Two asks: 1) Map CloudPartner sku -> our billing_key (CSV column "billing_key"). 2) Provide cadence for updates (daily/weekly). Also include commit_tiers with min_commit_months.
Mikel - PM: For modeling, we need historical spot volatility. Can they provide a 90-day spot price series per sku? If not, we'll approximate using their reported typical_preempt_pct.
Omar - Finance: Also need currency code and timestamped price effective dates (we model transitions). Add columns: currency, price_effective_from.
Sarah (Supply Ops): Sample accepted CSV header we should send to partner:
```
sku,region,start_date,end_date,reserved_price_usd_per_hr,spot_price_usd_per_hr,typical_preempt_pct,avg_capacity_per_hour,hourly_heatmap,lead_time_days,commit_window_months,billing_key,reliability_score,notes,currency,price_effective_from
```
Lucy (Partnerships): I pasted that into CloudPartner ticket. @VendorBot confirmed they can export in that shape but hourly_heatmap will be compressed as a 24-comma list string per row (e.g., "0.1,0.2,...").
Anita - Legal: Add column: "contract_min_price_floor_usd" if they have protected floors. Helps legal & finance.
Omar - Finance: Perfect. Once we have price_effective_from we can run scenario blending across commit windows. Also ask them for minimum commitment lead time (how many days between contract and start).
VendorBot: CloudPartner updated file: https://files.example.com/CloudPartner/availability_heatmap_v3.csv (sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924). They added currency and price_effective_from, but left contract_min_price_floor_usd blank for some SKUs.
Sarah (Supply Ops): Noted. We'll treat empty price_floor as no floor, but flag high-variance SKUs for manual review.
Mikel - PM: Action items: 1) @Omar validate whether we should model gross->net conversion now or in billing layer. 2) @Anita confirm contractual floor handling. 3) @Sarah build import mapping and fallback for hourly_heatmap compressed form.
Omar - Finance: I'll run a quick gross->net transform logic doc and post results by EOD.
Anita - Legal: I'll ask CloudPartner for a short clause template for price floors and commit termination windows.
Sarah (Supply Ops): I'll start the ingest script; sample parsing rule: if hourly_heatmap missing, expand avg_capacity_per_hour into uniform 24 vals; if compressed 24-list present, normalize to sum=1 and multiply by avg_capacity_per_hour.
Lucy (Partnerships): Thanks. One more: we should ask partners for an SLA-backed preemption SLA for reserved pools (e.g., <1% weekly eviction). That will feed reliability_score.
VendorBot: CloudPartner replied in ticket: can commit to reserved pool eviction <0.5% weekly for committed customers, will provide historical eviction logs for the last 30 days.
Mikel - PM: Awesome. Once ingest is wired, we can run sensitivity: price floor vs spot volatility vs commit window. Will schedule a 30-min sync next week.
Lucy (Partnerships): TY everyone. I'll close the ticket when we confirm the updated CSV ingest works. :pray:
